S12.01.note: I did not check the name of the activity-bar icon that opens the AGI sidebar, so the first step names only the view.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar view.
Click the "New chat" button (icon button at the top of the sidebar).
Look for an empty conversation area with no earlier messages and the composer ready at the bottom, with the headline "Start a conversation" and the line "Ask about your code or describe a change."
S12.01.where: Open the AGI sidebar view, then click the button titled "New chat" in the sidebar header. The empty screen shows "Start a conversation".

S12.03.note: I searched webviewContent.ts for a greeting, a personal name and personalization and found none; the new-chat headline is fixed text ("Start a conversation"), so there is no personal greeting to compare with the Expected rule.

S12.06.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
S12.06.note: The list is limited to three projects and is empty when signed out (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/startSuggestions.ts).
steps: Sign in and make sure you have at least one project.
Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Look for the "Projects" heading with up to three project rows, each with the detail "Use in this chat".
Click a project row and compare: the chat should open for that project, and the project should show in the "Active project" strip above the composer.
S12.06.where: Sidebar > New chat > Projects group > a project name row (button "Use in this chat").

S12.07.note: I found no recently-used-files group in startSuggestions.ts or the new-chat markup. The only file attach options are in the "+" menu ("Attach workspace files", "Open editors"), which is not a recent-file suggestion.

S12.08.needs: at least one enabled and consented Skill
S12.08.note: The group is hidden when no Skill is enabled and consented (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/startSuggestions.ts).
steps: Make sure at least one skill is enabled and consented.
Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Look for the "Skills" heading with up to three skill rows, each showing the skill's description.
Click a skill row and compare: the composer should fill with "Use the <skill name> skill to " ready for your request.
S12.08.where: Sidebar > New chat > Skills group > a skill name row.

S12.09.needs: a signed-in account with at least one connected app
S12.09.note: The group is shown only when connectors are allowed for the account and the app reports as connected (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/startSuggestions.ts).
steps: Connect at least one app or connector and sign in.
Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Look for the "Connected apps" heading with rows whose detail reads "Ask with it".
Click an app row and compare: the composer should fill with "Using <app name>, " ready for your request.
S12.09.where: Sidebar > New chat > Connected apps group > an app name row (detail "Ask with it").

S12.10.needs: a signed-in account; a search key for Local or BYOK (see "Set up web search" in the same menu)
S12.10.note: The menu description says "Local privacy mode refuses network"; I did not verify the final send-time behaviour.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Click the "+" button at the bottom left of the composer, then click "Browse the web".
Look for the chip "Browse the web for current sources" above the composer and the check state on "Browse the web".
Type a question that needs current information, send it, and compare: the web search should be used for that message only.
S12.10.where: Sidebar > composer "+" button (title "Attach or use tools") > "Browse the web".

S12.15.note: There is no separate "agentic" button on the new-chat screen; the agentic choice is made through the mode picker.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Click the button titled "Mode and reasoning effort" in the composer bottom row.
Choose "Auto" (or "Plan", or "Plan mode" from the "+" menu) and close the menu.
Send a task that needs several steps, such as "find and fix a failing test", and compare: it should run tool steps rather than a single plain answer.
S12.15.where: Sidebar > composer "Mode and reasoning effort" button > choose "Auto" (or "Plan" from the "+" menu as "Plan mode").

S12.16.note: I found no labelled coding-session entry on the new-chat screen or in commandSetup.ts; the nearest text is "Choose a folder to establish the developer-session scope" (webviewContent.ts), which is not a coding-session start control.

S12.18.note: The pill changes to the model name only after the CLI reports the session route (webviewContent.ts comment near line 3880), so a new chat may show "Auto" until then.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Look at the composer bottom row for the pill with the text "Auto" (its title is "Model").
Click the pill and compare: the list should show the model the next message will use.
S12.18.where: Sidebar > New chat > composer bottom row > model pill (default text "Auto").

S12.20.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
S12.20.note: I found no separate project dropdown before sending; the only pick is the Projects rows, and the ChatStateManager.ts line cited in the plan is a web-search check, not project selection.
steps: Sign in and open the AGI sidebar, then click "New chat".
Under "Projects", click the row for the project you want.
Look at the strip above the composer labelled "Active project" and confirm it shows that project's name.
Send a message and compare: the new chat should be created in that project.
S12.20.where: Sidebar > New chat > Projects group > "Use in this chat" on a project; the chosen project shows in the "Active project" strip.

S12.21.note: The example text is in the Command Palette mode picker (commandSetup.ts); I did not confirm that the sidebar popover shows examples.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Click the button titled "Mode and reasoning effort".
Read the description under each mode: "Ask", "Auto", "Plan", "Bypass permissions".
Open the mode picker from the Command Palette and compare: the "Ask" entry should show the example "Example: AGI can read parseDate while preparing a test, then asks before writing the file."
S12.21.where: Sidebar > New chat > "Mode and reasoning effort" button (mode list shows "Ask", "Auto", "Plan", "Bypass permissions"). Command palette: the "Modes" picker.

S12.22.needs: a fresh VS Code profile (first use)
S12.22.note: The intro shows only while the onboarding-seen flag (ONBOARDING_SEEN_KEY in apps/extension-vscode/src/features/onboarding/onboardingState.ts) is unset; I did not check that the sidebar shows it before the first chat.
steps: Use a fresh VS Code profile, or clear the stored onboarding flag, so the intro has not been seen.
Open the AGI sidebar view.
Read the step titled "Work with your code" and move through the steps; the progress reads "Setup · 1 of 4".
Compare: the steps should introduce the key features, and "Skip intro" should close the intro.
S12.22.where: First open of the AGI sidebar on a fresh profile: onboarding steps "Work with your code", "Follow cloud tasks", "Review changes in your editor", "Choose how actions are approved" (button "Skip intro").

S12.23.note: The draft is saved in the webview state for the new-chat thread (saveComposerDraft and restoreComposerDraft in webviewContent.ts); I did not check the exact step for the window reload command name.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar and click "New chat".
Type a sentence in the composer but do not send it.
Run a reload (for example, "Developer: Reload Window") or switch to another view and come back to the AGI sidebar.
Look at the composer and compare: the typed sentence should still be there.
S12.23.where: Sidebar > New chat > type text in the composer without sending, then reload the window or move away and back.
